title: DoorDash and Costco Expand Global Partnership with Nationwide U.S. Launch
summary: Costco members can order groceries, household essentials, electronics and more from all U.S. warehouses through DoorDash
body_markdown:
**Costco Wholesale Corporation** (NASDAQ: COST) and **DoorDash** (NASDAQ: DASH), a global leader in local commerce, today announced the launch of Costco on the DoorDash Marketplace across the U.S. The partnership brings Costco’s distinctive assortment to members through DoorDash, giving them greater flexibility in how they shop. The U.S. launch marks the latest expansion of DoorDash and Costco’s global relationship, which already spans Australia, New Zealand, Sweden, Iceland and Puerto Rico.


Costco ranked among the most-searched retailers not yet available on DoorDash. Today, DoorDash and Costco are meeting that customer demand: Costco members can now order groceries, pantry staples, household essentials, electronics, seasonal merchandise, Kirkland Signature products and more from all Costco warehouses nationwide through DoorDash for same-day delivery.


> “Costco members have been asking for Costco on DoorDash, and today we’re delivering,” said Mike Goldblatt, Vice President of Enterprise Partnerships at DoorDash. “By pairing Costco’s quality, value and selection with DoorDash’s reach and local delivery network, we’re giving members more flexibility in how they shop. The U.S. launch also marks the next chapter in a global partnership already serving Costco members around the world.”


With Costco on board, DoorDash now partners with 8 of the 10 largest food retailers in North America, according to Progressive Grocer’s[PG 100](https://progressivegrocer.com/pg-100-2026-ranking-top-food-retailers?email-confirmed=true) .


**How It Works** Costco members in the U.S. can open the DoorDash app, search for Costco and select their local warehouse, where they can shop more than 4,000 products. When prompted, they can link an active Costco membership and complete their order. Consumers who are not yet Costco members can follow a link to Costco.com to purchase a membership, then return to DoorDash and link their new account.
